questions.q: Which bank account use must be enabled on essentially every bank account, regardless of its other uses?
questions.explain: The Cash Management use is what lets an account participate in reconciliation and positioning; it is needed on every account.

questions.q: What happens if a bank account does not have the Payables disbursement use assigned?
options: It will not appear as an option for paying suppliers
It can still pay suppliers, just without reconciliation
It automatically gets secured by users and roles
It is deleted from the Bank Account Model
questions.explain: Assigning a use is what makes an account selectable in other modules; without the disbursement use, it won't show up for paying suppliers.

questions.q: Which layer of bank account security grants access to an entire business unit or function without naming individual people?
questions.explain: Bank account access security grants access by business unit or function, a broader grant than naming individual users or roles.

questions.q: If a bank account's "Secure Bank Account by Users and Roles" flag is set to Yes, what is required to use that account?
options: Only membership in the owning business unit
Nothing extra — the flag has no practical effect
Being individually named, or holding a role explicitly named, on that account
A one-time password sent by the bank
questions.explain: When that flag is Yes, business-unit or function access alone is not enough — the user must be named or carry a named role on the account.

questions.q: Which privilege is required to modify the User and Role Security tab on a bank account?
questions.explain: The Manage Bank Account Security privilege specifically controls who can modify a bank account's User and Role Security tab.
